data.name: Athena M128-16 — 128 KiB / 16-bit 2 µm RAM module

introduced.event_name: NCC 1983 — planned ERA² and Logix Athena premiere
introduced.timeline_note: Planned premiere on the opening day of NCC, 16–19 May 1983; not a confirmed shipment date.

data.product_status: Accepted planning baseline; production and electrical qualification pending.

specification.installation: Matched pairs, power off; no hot swap. Athena controller must decode every rank and refresh all populated arrays.
specification.electrical_interface: Connector, rank selection, timing/loading and mechanical fit require Athena qualification; not automatically interchangeable with Artemis modules.
